lead: Arjun Rampal is an Indian film actor, born on 26 November 1972 in Jabalpur.
As of 2026, he is 53 years old, and his birth date places him under the Sagittarius sign.
He has 47 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actor and National Film Award for Best Supporting Actor.
This profile collects the Arjun facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
